title: DATA↔MLOPS-001: Dataset Versioning + Lineage at the Model Boundary
description: Data provides versioned datasets, in-pipeline data validation, and lineage at the model boundary; MLOps provides the dataset-versioning integration approach and the data requirements derived from training and retraining. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3 and MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4.

lineage.description: Lineage at the model boundary (source → transform → training set).

lineage_complete.description: True only if every training record is traceable to a source (no untracked data).

mlops_requirements.description: MLOPS→DATA: versioning-integration approach + training data requirements.

retraining_trigger.description: What triggers a retraining-data pull (schedule, drift, new labels).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine dataset versioning/lineage exchange is agent-autonomous. Lineage feeds the closed-loop retraining path; a lineage gap that re-baselines a drift monitor on contaminated data is an FC-022 escalation (Tier-2).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (versioning-integration alignment at planning; data-pipeline integration during development; retraining-data reviews)
confirm_conditions: dataset_delivery carries a dataset_id and a dvc_version
lineage has ≥1 source_ref and lineage_complete with traceable transform steps
in_pipeline_validation_passed = true before the dataset crosses the model boundary
reject_conditions: lineage_complete = true while transform_steps or source_refs are absent (untraceable training data)
dataset promoted to training without a DVC version (irreproducible)
a CRITICAL/HIGH DQIR open against the dataset (blocks the training pipeline — see ML↔DATA-DQIR-002)
counter_conditions: retraining trigger draws from a window that may include drifted production data — request provenance review (FC-022)
feature definitions changed since last version — request a feature-spec diff before retraining
